subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym to replace the bold word.

It was a ***desolate*** wasteland except for some grazing sheep.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e. '**Lonely'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most **appropriate synonym** to replace the bold word **"desolate" is 4) lonely.**
 
• **Desolate** means deserted, barren, or uninhabited. (उजाड़)
 
• **It refers **to a place or area that is empty, bleak, and lacking in life or human activity.
 
• **Lonely: **Lonely means feeling alone, isolated, or without companionship. (अकेला)
 
• **It captures** the sense of emptiness and lack of human presence associated with "desolate."

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Lonely'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of the meanings of the options:
 
 
• **Cheerful **means happy, positive, or full of good spirits. (प्रसन्न)
 
• **Cordial **means warm, friendly, or sincere. (स्नेहपूर्ण)
 
• **Festive** means joyful, celebratory, or related to a festive occasion. (उत्सवी)
